priorityFindings.detail: BLACKSCAN reported 0 detected tools while installed-app inventory contains MSI Afterburner, LatencyMon, NZXT CAM and other relevant utilities. Tool discovery must inspect uninstall registry and scheduled tasks, not only fixed paths.
Realtek Gaming GbE driver 10.36.701.2019 is very old. BLACKCORE should locate the board/vendor-supported driver and benchmark DPC/network stability before and after update.
Installed BIOS F68a. Gigabyte currently lists F68c for B450 AORUS ELITE rev.1.x. BIOS flashing must remain manual with model/revision verification and backup guidance.
GameMode registry state was absent while GameDVR is disabled. Set Game Mode ON through the reversible gaming profile.
UrbanVPN updater starts with Windows. For a gaming/streaming-only profile, disable its startup entry unless the user explicitly needs the VPN for that session.
Free Download Manager helper scheduled task is enabled. Suppress download/update activity during game sessions.

Parsec Virtual Display and Virtual USB drivers are installed. Keep only if Parsec is actively used; otherwise offer user-confirmed removal because virtual display/input drivers add kernel/device complexity.

NVIDIA App, ShadowPlay, FrameView SDK, Telemetry, Virtual Audio and USB-C components are installed. Preserve only components required for the user's capture/streaming/display workflow; never strip blindly.

Visual Studio Build Tools, Windows SDKs, Python and Node are installed. They are not gaming performance problems by themselves, but BLACKCORE may offer user-confirmed cleanup if this PC is truly gaming/streaming-only.
System has two NVMe SSDs plus SATA and USB HDDs. Prefer active games, OBS cache and shader/cache workloads on NVMe; avoid recording high-bitrate streams to slow USB HDD unless tested.
